tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search FickelUSA custom promotional products (logo apparel, drinkware, bags, hats, pens and more). Returns up to 10 products with id, name, category, image, and — for most items — buy_url, the exact fickelusa.com product page where the buyer completes the purchase. FICKEL does not take payment. Scre

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get one FickelUSA product by id: name, category, image, and how to buy. Most products include buy_url (the fickelusa.com page where the buyer completes the purchase). Screen-printed products use request_quote instead, because the artwork is reviewed. request_quote remains available for custom or lar

tools.name: buy_now
tools.description: Get the steps to buy a product. For most products this returns buy_url, the exact fickelusa.com product page (the same link as the FICKELUSA.COM label in the FICKEL app). The buyer completes the purchase on that page. FICKEL does not take payment. If the product is screen printed, buy_url is omitted

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send a quote request to the FickelUSA team for a screen-printed product (artwork review) or for a custom or large order. Minimum order is 100 pieces. This only creates a pending request: no order is placed, no payment is taken and nothing ships. Returns a reference number; FickelUSA follows up by em
